qa_pairs.question: What torque should be applied to valve housing to valve body bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: 5 Nm with M6 screws for all transmission types.

qa_pairs.question: How much torque is required for the 4HP-22/4HP-24/A5S 310Z/A5S 440Z/A5S 300J valve body bolts?
Which hydraulic/electronic control element uses reference 1AZ?
What component is identified by reference 2AZ in the automatic transmission hydraulic control elements?
What is the highest torque value listed for automatic transmission hydraulic/electronic control elements?
qa_pairs.answer: 20 Nm for A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmissions using 5/16" screws.
